blocks.content: Master these one-liners for the final revision before your exam:

items: HP formed: 15 April 1948 (Chief Commissioner's Province); Full State: 25 January 1971 (18th state).
Capital: Shimla; Winter/Second Capital: Dharamshala (since 2017).
Districts: 12; Vidhan Sabha seats: 68 (unicameral); Lok Sabha: 4; Rajya Sabha: 3.
First CM: Dr. Y.S. Parmar; First Governor: S. Chakravarti.
Current CM (2024): Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu (INC); Governor: Shiv Pratap Shukla.
Largest district (area): Lahaul-Spiti (13,835 sq km). Smallest: Hamirpur (1,118 sq km).
Largest district (population): Kangra. Smallest: Lahaul-Spiti.
Highest Peak: Reo Purgyil (6816 m), Kinnaur. Lowest point: Dhaula Kuan, Sirmaur (~300 m).
State Tree: Deodar. State Flower: Pink Rhododendron (Burans). State Bird: Western Tragopan (Jujurana). State Animal: Snow Leopard.
Longest river in HP: Sutlej. It enters from Tibet via Shipkila Pass (Kinnaur).
Gobind Sagar (Bhakra Dam on Sutlej) – largest man-made lake. Renuka Lake – largest natural lake.
Chandratal (Moon Lake): Lahaul-Spiti; crescent-shaped; 4250 m altitude; Ramsar candidate.
Atal Tunnel (Rohtang): 8.9 km; world's longest highway tunnel above 10,000 ft; opened Oct 2020.
Kalka-Shimla Railway: 96.6 km narrow gauge; 102 tunnels; UNESCO World Heritage Site (2008).
Great Himalayan NP (Kullu): UNESCO World Heritage Site (2014); habitat of Western Tragopan.
Nathpa Jhakri HEP: 1500 MW; Sutlej; Kinnaur/Shimla; largest HEP in HP.
HP hydropower potential: ~27,436 MW (~25% of India's total).
Tabo Monastery: Founded 996 CE; Spiti; oldest in HP; 'Ajanta of Himalayas'.
Chamba Rumal and Kullu Shawl and Kinnauri Shawl and Kangra Tea: GI tagged products of HP.
Nati (Naati): HP's most popular folk dance; Guinness Book – largest traditional dance performance.
HP High Court: Established 25 January 1971 in Shimla.
HP Police Act 2007 governs HP Police (replaced 1861 Act).
BBN (Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh) in Solan: Largest industrial hub; major pharma cluster.
Shimla Municipal Corporation: Highest urban local body; city at ~2206 m altitude.
Masrur Rock-cut Temples (Kangra): 9th century; UNESCO tentative World Heritage Site.
Jwala Mukhi temple (Kangra): Perpetual natural gas flames; Shakti Peeth; Akbar donated gold canopy.
Naina Devi temple (Bilaspur): Shakti Peeth; above Gobind Sagar Lake.
Chintpurni temple (Una): Shakti Peeth; Sati's chin/feet fell here.
Baba Balak Nath temple (Deotsidh, Hamirpur): Most visited temple in HP.
First Param Vir Chakra: Major Somnath Sharma (posthumous), from Kangra, 1947.
McLeod Ganj (Dharamshala): Seat of Tibetan Government in Exile; residence of Dalai Lama.
Kangra Painting School: Lyrical naturalism; Krishna-Radha; patronized by Sansar Chand.
Basholi Paintings: Bold, vivid colors; angular; forerunner of Kangra style.
Chail (Solan): World's highest cricket ground (2250 m); built 1893 by Maharaja Bhupinder Singh of Patiala.
Bir Billing (Kangra): Paragliding Capital of India.
World's highest post office: Hikkim, Spiti (14,567 ft).
World's highest polling station: Tashigang, Spiti (15,256 ft).
Pragpur (Kangra): First declared Heritage Village of India.
Mandi Shivratri Fair: 'International Shivratri Fair'; hundreds of deities; February-March.
Kullu Dussehra: Started by Raja Jagat Singh (1660 CE); 7-day international fair; 200+ deities.
Minjar Fair (Chamba): Started 935 CE; marks maize harvest; Ravi river procession in July-August.
Lavi Fair (Rampur, Shimla): November; ancient trade fair with Kinnauri-Tibetan traders.
HP Statehood Day: 25 January (same as Republic Day).
Spiti receives only ~170 mm rain/year (cold desert). Dharamshala ~3400 mm/year (wettest in HP).
HP is called 'Dev Bhoomi' (Land of Gods), 'Water Tower of North India', 'Fruit Bowl of India'.
Bara Shigri: Longest glacier in HP; second longest in India; in Lahaul.
Rohtang Pass (3978 m): Kullu-Lahaul boundary; tourist hotspot; controlled entry now.
HPCA Stadium, Dharamshala: Highest Test cricket ground in India (1457 m).
HP Police Training College: Daroh, Kangra.
HP formed from 31 princely states + 4 chieftainships on 15 April 1948.
Bilaspur merged with HP on 1 July 1954 (it was previously a separate Part C state).
1966: Kangra, Kullu, Lahaul-Spiti, Shimla, Sirmaur transferred from Punjab to HP.
HP is a landlocked state with no sea coast.
Shimla: State capital; elevation 2206 m; British summer capital since 1864.
IIT Mandi (2009), IIM Sirmaur (2015), NIT Hamirpur (1986): National institutes in HP.
Solan: 'Mushroom City of India'; major pharmaceutical hub of HP.
Paonta Sahib (Sirmaur): On Yamuna River; Gurudwara Paonta Sahib (Guru Gobind Singh's stay).
Rewalsar Lake (Mandi): Sacred to Hindus, Sikhs, Buddhists; floating islands.
HP Old Pension Scheme restored in 2023 – one of first states to do so.
Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu became HP CM on 11 December 2022 after INC won 2022 assembly elections.
Kangana Ranaut: Bollywood actress; from Bhambla village, Mandi district.
Anupam Kher: Bollywood actor; born in Shimla; Padma Bhushan.
Thakur Sen Negi: Oldest voter of India; from Kinnaur; voted at 100+ years of age.
HP has 77 development blocks and approximately 3,615 Gram Panchayats.
